# Make workspace restore confirmation keyboard accessible

## What & Why
The restore confirmation is a destructive replacement step. Keyboard users should be able to identify the dialog, move focus into it, dismiss it with Escape, and return focus to the restore control without relying on a mouse.

## Done looks like
- Opening the restore confirmation moves focus to a meaningful dialog control
- Escape and the cancel action dismiss the dialog without changing workspace state
- Focus does not escape the modal while it is open and returns to the restore trigger afterward
